scene_description: A 30x30 block workshop area organized around the player spawn point. Northeast quadrant contains a dual-wall structure (andesite wall at x=8 + stone brick wall at x=9, both 3 blocks tall) with nether brick slabs on top. Northwest quadrant has a woodworking area marked by a white banner with a fletching table behind it. A diagonal trail of orange concrete blocks leads from mid-scene southeast toward a lava lake (3x3 source blocks in an obsidian basin) with an adjacent 2-block-tall stone brick cliff and a cobblestone step for access.
task_text: Explore this workshop village: find the andesite wall and nether brick slab atop it, mine the stone brick wall nearby, follow the white banner to the fletching table and build a fence, then follow the orange concrete markers to the lava lake and build a lava fall from the cliff.

Player ascent: ground(y=0) → jump onto cobblestone(top=y=1) → jump onto cliff(top=y=2). Lava placed at y=2 flows down creating lava fall.
